title: Drill codes
description: Each focus area has 20 slots for your own drill codes. An empty slot won't be used in a practice.
orgDescription: These drill codes are the shared standard of {organization}. They are set by the head coach, so every coach records practices the same way and analytics stay comparable across the organization.
glossaryToggle: What the default (example only) codes mean
glossaryNote: These are only starter codes. Keep them, or rename any slot to your own drill — your analytics follow whatever codes you use.
examplesNote: Just examples to get you started — your slots stay empty. Name your drills your own way.

errors.orgReadOnly: Drill codes are set by your organization's head coach.
